scope: unfitted original UNIFAC ternary-subdomain comparison; synthetic midpoint flash input
method: Feed = 0.5*x_phase1 + 0.5*x_phase2 with total 1 mol. Default solver seeds only. Match predicted endpoint order by minimum squared composition distance. No parameter fitting.
uncertaintyPolicy: Do not fabricate missing closure-component uncertainties or claim a statistical chi-square fit. Endpoint RMSE has mole-fraction units.
limitations: No experimental phase amounts, settling, entrainment or heat duties
Original article tables not visually inspected; source is NIST/TRC transcription cross-checked against its XML
No global stability proof; two-phase solver can miss candidates
Failure rows never silently dropped from overall count
